hero.title: Optimal transport, geometry, and machine learning.
hero.subtitle: I'm Mao Nishino, a PhD candidate in Mathematics at Florida State University. My research interests include optimal transport, deep learning, Riemannian & metric geometry, and data science.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.text: Email is best. You can also find me on LinkedIn, GitHub, and Researchmap.

optimal_transport.title: Optimal transport
optimal_transport.body: I study the theory and applications of optimal transport, with a particular emphasis on Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao and Gromov–Wasserstein distances.

deep_learning.title: Deep learning
deep_learning.body: I investigate adversarial attacks targeting both language and vision models, developing robust methodologies and evaluation protocols.

projects.subtitle: Research software and experiments I have developed.

acuot.body: ACUOT is a research codebase that explores optimal transport-based models, providing training scripts, evaluation utilities, and reproducible experiment settings.
